newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka closes weaker on dollar demand.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka closes weaker on dollar demand.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka eased after a steady start and closed at 42.5450/42.5500 to the dollar in interbank trading on higher demand for the U.S. currency, dealers said.
The taka was quoted at 42.5420/42.5490 to the dollar in early trading compared with the previous close of 42.5430/42.5490.
"The demand for dollars rose later in the session. Banks were under pressure for import payments," said a dealer with a foreign bank.
Dealers said the interbank call money rates closed firmer at 4.25 percent to 5.0 percent against the previous 4.0 to 5.0 percent.
